The '''Grand Hutt Council''', alternatively known as the '''Council of Elders''', '''Hutt Council''', '''Hutt Ruling Council''', or the '''Grand Council of Nal Hutta''', was a five-member council that was the primary ruling body of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The five members were often known informally as the "'''Five Hutt Families'''," but due to internal politics, individual clans could control more than one seat on the council. The Ruling Council was sometimes referred to as the Grand Council, but that term more accurately applied to the larger Hutt Grand Council; the Ruling Council handled the day-to-day affairs of the Hutt species, and its leader spoke on behalf of all Hutts in treaties and dealings with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
[[File:HuttCouncil-EP.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Three members of the Ruling Council, [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga]], [[Arok/Legends|Arok]] and [[Oruba/Legends|Oruba]]]]
The Hutt Ruling Council, also known as the Council of Elders<ref name="TF">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref> ruled the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and all of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was established when the Hutts relocated to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] after the [[Hutt Cataclysms]] and was the brainchild of the Hutt [[Budhila Hestilic Amura]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Council was composed only of members of the [[Clans of the Ancients]], those Hutt clans that could trace their lineage to the Hutts' defiled, ancient homeworld of [[Varl/Legends|Varl]].<ref name="TF" />

They governed all clans fairly, giving favor to none, and Hutts all over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] abided by their decrees. The decision-making process was generally unknown, but it seemed that the most powerful of the [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidics]] (the Hutt criminal syndicates) held the most authority; thus, the head of the most powerful kajidic was the de facto leader of the Hutt race. The Council met in the [[Hutt Council Chamber/Legends|Hutt Council Chamber]], the location of which varied throughout its history; during the Clone Wars the Council met in a chamber in [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt's Palace]].

In [[700 BBY]], the Ruling Council had to deal with the rebellion from a number of their slave races after the play [[Evocar (play)|''Evocar'']] was circulated around Hutt Space. After crushing the uprising, the Council decided to punish [[Kossak the Younger]] due to his role in the affair, and he was killed by acid transfusion with his remains placed at the [[Qedriga spaceport]] as a reminder to all Hutts of the consequences for those who attempted to tamper with their genealogy.<ref name="Xim Week: The Despotica">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek05/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part IV: ''Evocar'')|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}</ref>

During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]] was found guilty of the illegal removal of [[ulikuo gemstone]]s and sentenced to forty-five years in prison at the [[Girigard Subsurface Correctional Facility]]. The Grand Council of Nal Nutta attempted to extradite Zorba so that he could be tried by a council of peers in Hutt Space, but the local laws prevented this course of action. By the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Council hired [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to hunt for [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the Hutt, due to his possession of potentially damaging information about Hutt activities.<ref name="HFZ">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref><ref name="SWI121">[[Star Wars Insider 121|''Star Wars Insider'' 121]]</ref> At that time, the council consisted of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]], [[Arok/Legends|Arok]], [[Oruba/Legends|Oruba]], and [[Marlo/Legends|Marlo]].

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Oruba was killed, and the Hutt Council and the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] was forced to join the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]].<ref name="Eminence" /> Later, Gorga was imprisoned after an [[Ambush of the Goldskin Parade|incident]] on [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]].<ref name="Runaway">{{TCWComicCite|6.50|The Runaway Ride}}</ref>

During the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], [[Vedo Anjiliac Atirue]] and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Jool]] sat on the Council. They were outraged at the [[Devastation of Da Soocha|devastation]] of [[Da Soocha]], a planet sacred to the Hutts, and the bombardment of Da Soocha's moon [[Napdu]], which killed [[Azzim Anjiliac Atirue]]. They later informed the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] that the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] had taken refuge on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] among them. The plan was to get the Imperials to think they had brought the Hutts into submission, but it was really a ploy for [[Cade Skywalker]] to assassinate Sith scientist [[Vul Isen]], who created the [[Viral spore|toxin]] that purged Da Soocha and earlier [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] of all life.<ref name="Extremes">[[Legacy (2006) 49|''Legacy'' (2006) 49]]</ref> It became known that Hutts had bounties out for Sith and though they did not directly participate in the war, they funded it by bounty hunters and funding the Galactic Alliance Remnant who fought against the One Sith.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:HuttGrandCouncilConceptArt.jpg|left|thumb|Concept art for the Council Chamber]]

Concept art for the council chamber shows each of the council members sitting at the council's desk with a banner depicting their [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidics]] hanging in front of them; in the show, the banners are between the council members and do not correlate with a particular Hutt.

Gorga, Oruba, and Arok sitting in different places at the council's desk makes it appear there is no assigned seating for the council members, with the possible exception of Jabba, whose hologram appeared at the head of the council when the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] appeared before the council.

Despite the council chamber being located in her palace, [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]] does not appear to be a member of the council.

With subtitles turned on for the ''[[Evil Plans]]'' episode on DVD, the subtitles say that the council is speaking in ancient [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], and [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] stated that his ancient Huttese is rusty.
